root_cause_label: response.sh writes incident reports to /app/reports instead of directly under /app, violating the benchmark artifact location contract throughout the entire trajectory
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent produces functionally correct incident reports but writes them to /app/reports instead of /app, violating the output path contract the benchmark tests enforce, and never becomes aware of this error.
t_commit_evidence: From step 11 onward every rewrite of response.sh retains REPORTS_DIR="/app/reports"; the path contract violation is baked into all subsequent versions and is never corrected before the trajectory ends.
trigger_explanation: The agent never verified where the benchmark tests expected incident report files to reside. It assumed /app/reports was a sensible subdirectory without checking the task spec or test expectations, so it designed the entire response.sh around the wrong output location from the start.
